- i: And again he said: 'Our mother Zion,' a man will say, 'and a man was born in her, and he, the Most High, founded her.' And as Solomon, his son, prophesied and said: 'Truly God will be with men and will walk about upon the earth.' And as his father David prophesied and said: 'He will come down like dew upon the fleece, and like the drop that drips upon the earth, and righteousness will spring up in his days.'

Words in this part: 359.
